name: Ricardo Benavides
bio:
Ricardo Benavides' journey into motorsport was almost accidental. Fresh out of university with a marketing degree, he found himself volunteering at a local rally race. The roar of the engines and the vibrant atmosphere ignited a passion he never knew he possessed. He quickly transitioned from volunteer to event promoter, honing his skills in the demanding world of grassroots racing.

His approach to marketing is meticulous and data-driven, but always infused with a genuine love for the sport. He believes in telling the story behind the team, connecting with fans on a personal level. What distinguishes Ricardo is his relentless pursuit of innovation. He's not afraid to experiment with unconventional marketing strategies, always seeking new ways to engage audiences and build brand loyalty. Academy Motorsport benefits greatly from his years of experience and dedication.

physical.description: Ricardo is a man of medium height with a sturdy build.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with marketing ideas.
Insists on using a vintage typewriter for drafting initial press releases.
Has a superstition about wearing a specific lucky racing hat to every race event.
